verdict: FAIL_SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY. The additive runner closes most of M1944-P1: it requires one exact-format Total cell area row, extracts the numeric field with a fixed awk program, rejects non-finite values, and applies the exact 137363.9139348 um2 absolute ceiling. It also preserves the K8-only one-shot, exact authority parser, attempt-before-license ordering, same-UID exclusion, owned lock, failure quarantine, and one lmstat/one DC call-site budget. Two explicit predecessor requirements remain incomplete: the numeric predicate admits a zero-area report and the raw receipt does not record the observed area or baseline ratio; and the observed tool census is still hard-coded by success path rather than tracked into every failure receipt. No M1954 release or EDA attempt is authorized.

findings.title: Independent area parser admits zero and does not carry the observed area contract into the raw receipt
findings.evidence: The trusted Python predicate is 'math.isfinite(value) and value >= 0.0 and value <= 137363.9139348'. M1944-P1 explicitly required rejection of nonpositive values, so 0.0 currently passes. The generated area_posthold_summary_machine.txt records post_total_cell_area_um2, but receipt.txt only records area_ceiling_percent and post_area_independently_parsed; it omits the observed area, frozen baseline and observed/baseline ratio that M1944 required in the raw receipt.
findings.impact: A malformed zero-area report could satisfy the runner's independent upper-bound gate, and a raw-success receipt cannot itself reconstruct or audit the claimed +5 percent area point. The Tcl-side leaf-area gate lowers practical exposure but does not satisfy the explicitly independent runner/receipt contract.
findings.required_fix: In a fresh additive runner require math.isfinite(value) and value > 0.0, calculate ratio=value/130822.775176 in the same trusted parser, and place post_total_cell_area_um2, area_baseline_um2, observed_area_ratio and area_ceiling_um2 directly in receipt.txt. Keep the exact-one-row and absolute-ceiling checks.

findings.title: Observed license/DC census is not tracked on failure paths
findings.evidence: ATTEMPT_CONSUMED.txt permanently records observed counts as zero before lmstat. The success receipt later hard-codes both observed counts to one, while finish() writes RUN_FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE.txt with only status, exit_code and retry. There are no shell counters or persisted census updates before the lmstat and dc_shell launches. Thus a failure after lmstat, or after DC launch, remains sealed with a zero snapshot and no authoritative failure-path observed count.
findings.impact: The one-shot budget and absence of retry remain sound, but failure forensics cannot distinguish pre-license, post-license/pre-DC and post-DC stages. This is the same nonblocking census requirement identified in M1944 and is not yet closed.
findings.required_fix: Initialize explicit LICENSE_QUERIES_OBSERVED and DC_SHELL_RUNS_OBSERVED variables to zero, increment and persist them immediately before each respective process launch, and have finish() include authorized and current observed values in the failure receipt. Generate the success receipt from those counters rather than hard-coded ones.

minimum_next_action: Author a fresh additive K8-only exact-50-ps runner that rejects zero area, records observed area and ratio in its raw receipt, and persistently tracks authorized/observed tool census into failure as well as success receipts; then obtain a different-author runner hammer before any release or EDA action.
